model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various language families on different models, with each language family represented on the horizontal axis, labeled as "family", and listed in the order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect", ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5, from 0 to 30. Each language family is associated with six bars, grouped together, representing different models: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (red). The height of each bar corresponds to its effect value, with error bars indicating the range of values. The values of the bars vary across language families and models, with IE-Indic having the highest values, with mBERT-R2 at approximately 18 and mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 both around 23, while Isolate and Uralic have the lowest values, mostly below 2. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the bars within each group or across the different language families.
